title: Large-Scale Aggregation with PySpark
title_es: Agregaciones a Gran Escala con PySpark
description: How to perform group-by aggregations on large datasets with PySpark, covering window functions, UDFs, broadcast joins, and partition tuning.
description_es: Como realizar agregaciones group-by en datasets grandes con PySpark, cubriendo window functions, UDFs, broadcast joins y tuning de performance.
